title: What is the Max plan? | Claude Help Center

facts.fact: Anthropic's help center states the Max plan is available for $100 per month for web subscriptions.
facts.quote: The Max plan is available for $100 per month.

facts.fact: Anthropic states the $100 Max price applies to web subscriptions only, and mobile pricing may vary by app platform.
facts.quote: This price is for web subscriptions only. Mobile pricing may vary depending on your app platform.

facts.fact: Anthropic states Max plan usage is five times the Pro plan's usage every five hours and every week.
facts.quote: Get five times the Pro plan's usage every five hours and every week.

facts.fact: Anthropic states the Max plan is currently offered only as a monthly subscription.
facts.quote: The Max plan is currently available as a monthly subscription only.

facts.fact: Anthropic states Max plan prices and plans are subject to change at its discretion.
facts.quote: Price and plans are subject to change at Anthropic's discretion.

facts.fact: Anthropic states that when upgrading from Max to Ultra, the account is charged on a prorated basis for the remainder of the billing cycle.
facts.quote: When upgrading from Max to Ultra, your account will be charged on a prorated basis for the remainder of your billing cycle.

facts.fact: Anthropic states that when moving from an annual Pro plan to Max, a credit for the remaining Pro balance is issued if that balance exceeds the Max price, provided the billing address is unchanged.
facts.quote: if the remaining balance on your annual Pro plan is greater than your Max plan price, you will receive a credit to your account for the remaining balance.

facts.fact: Anthropic states that for subscriptions purchased through Google Play, the full price of the new plan is charged on upgrade and unused value becomes extra days, so renewal lands a few days later than a full month.
facts.quote: If you subscribed through Google Play, you're charged the full price of your new plan when you upgrade.

facts.fact: Anthropic states it does not offer standard discounted pricing for individual plans (Pro, Max, and Ultra).
facts.quote: We don't offer standard discounted pricing for individual plans (Pro, Max, and Ultra)

facts.fact: Anthropic states Max plan subscribers receive monthly API credits, which are included with Max, Ultra, and Team plans.
facts.quote: Claude Max, Ultra, and Team plans include monthly credits for the Claude API.

facts.fact: Anthropic describes the Max plan as a paid plan for individual consumers, with organizations directed to Team and Enterprise plans instead.
facts.quote: This article is about paid Max plans for individual consumers.
